# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Native rendering reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 will improve rendering reliability through native engine fixes. The upcoming update addresses image-filter caching, mask-filtered glyph rendering, and specific Vulkan allocation failures on Imagination drivers.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Consistent image-filter caching** — Aligns image-filter cache-key equality with hashing, including signed-zero representations and matrix type metadata, so key lookup and eviction use consistent key identity. ([#5769](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5769))
- **Correct mask-filtered glyph handling** — Uses the reloaded glyph's outline when successive font-scaler loads disagree. Clears incompatible masks instead of overflowing sub-byte rows and preserves full plane strides when copying clipped emboss masks. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741))
- **Imagination Vulkan allocation workaround** — Avoids a driver failure when descriptor-set allocation reports host or device out-of-memory on Imagination GPUs. Ganesh and Graphite deliberately abandon the affected pool rather than destroy it; Graphite also blocks further allocation through that handle. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741))
